text: MegaFon PJSC is wholly owned by Alisher Usmanov's USM Holding: USM told RIA Novosti in 2020 that all MegaFon shares were consolidated at shareholder USM, and MegaFon's 2022 annual report lists OOO USM Telecom (50%) and OOO AF Telecom Holding (50%, whose sole owner is USM Telecom) as its only shareholders.
short: MegaFon is 100% owned by Alisher Usmanov's USM Holding.

source.name: Prime/РИА Новости via finance.rambler.ru: 'Холдинг USM консолидировал 100% акций «Мегафона»'
source.quote: USM Holding Алишера Усманова консолидировал 100% акций "Мегафона", сообщил РИА Новости гендиректор оператора Геворк Вермишян.
source.note: Translation: 'Alisher Usmanov's USM Holding consolidated 100% of MegaFon shares, MegaFon CEO Gevork Vermishyan told RIA Novosti.' Same page: 'все акции «Мегафона» будут консолидированы у акционера компании – USM' (all MegaFon shares consolidated at shareholder USM) and AF Telecom Holding's sole owner is USM Telecom.

additionalSources.name: MegaFon PJSC: Годовой отчет за 2022 год (annual report, PDF), p. 2
additionalSources.quote: акционерами ПАО «МегаФон» являлись ООО «АФ Телеком Холдинг» (50%) и ООО «ЮэСэМ Телеком» (50%), которые в совокупности владели 100% уставного капитала Компании
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'the shareholders of MegaFon PJSC were AF Telecom Holding LLC (50%) and USM Telecom LLC (50%), which together owned 100% of the company's charter capital.' The 2025 annual report (approved 2026-04-16) no longer discloses shareholder composition pursuant to Government Decree No 1102.
